entries.entry: Country office reports two staff have not checked in since 07:45 on the Karun to Hadar road.
Crisis management team activated; team lead chairs; meeting every two hours.
All movements on the corridor stopped pending review.
Family liaison officer assigned; families are contacted only by that officer.
Alert shared with other agencies' security focal points; legal advises the media line states only that contact has been lost.

openDecisions: Whether to relocate non-essential staff from the Hadar base.
Wording of the first public statement.
